question.text: An investor wants details about the trustees overseeing a mutual fund — including the trustee company's experience, key personnel, and rights and obligations. Which document should the investor refer to?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p103, the SAI gives complete details of mutual fund constituents — including Sponsors, AMC, Trustee Company and service providers — covering experience, key personnel, and rights and obligations. Trustees oversee all schemes of an AMC, so their details are AMC-level information disclosed in the SAI. The Trap: The SID covers scheme-level information such as the fund manager. Candidates who confuse fund managers with trustees may pick SID. KIM is a summary; Fact Sheets focus on portfolio data. Note: Governance structure (trustees, AMC, service providers) is disclosed in the SAI per p103 — a frequently tested compliance point.
